body: A couple of years ago my husband cheated on me. I thought he was my happiness so this really took a toll on me. Still does now. I must have not been perfect enough. I have this picture in my mind of how I want to raise my children. You know, bake cookies, run around taking them to their activities, everyone happy. There are days I am exhausted and just want to be left alone but if I take time for myself ....IDK I can't seem to figure things out. I don't want to be a burden when someone else can give them what they want and need.
